issues.parameter: Orbital period precision and TESS reliability
issues.competing_evidence: Gänsicke+09 Table 1 gives 84.3(3) min; Kolbin+23 p. 4 gives 84.0653±0.0002 min from LS photometry and a low-state r-band ephemeris; Hernández-Díaz+25 Table A1 gives 84.07210±0.00330 min from one TESS sector. The TESS target has Tmag=17.663, in the paper’s 17<T<19 uncertain-reliability regime. The latter two differ by 0.0068 min (about 2.06σ if quoted errors are independent).
issues.why_it_matters: A claimed period change or selected high-precision period could affect synchronization and evolutionary comparisons; the published TESS methodology flags this target brightness as uncertain.
issues.needed_action: Inspect the TESS light curve and source-specific PSD S/N/recovery or obtain an independent timed epoch before preferring one value or inferring Pdot. Until then retain values separately and do not infer Pdot.

issues.parameter: Szkody+05 primary-text verification of polar classification, polarization, 33 MG cyclotron field, and approximate 1.4 h period
issues.competing_evidence: Kolbin+23 full text and Ferrario+15 Table 2 quote Szkody+05 for circular polarization up to 9%, a cyclotron spot field near 33 MG, and an approximate period; Gänsicke+09 independently lists an 84.3(3) min period. Szkody+05 DOI metadata resolves, but the original paper body was not retrieved.
issues.why_it_matters: The secondary-reported spot field and polarization are important to component-specific magnetic comparisons.
issues.needed_action: Provide or retrieve the Szkody+05 paper and verify the BM CrB row, observing band/state, cyclotron harmonic identification, and exact period/polarimetry values; otherwise keep these claims labeled secondary.
issues.public_status: Awaiting access to the original source

issues.parameter: 4XMM/Ridder X-ray band conversion and absorption convention
issues.competing_evidence: The exact 4XMM-DR11 slim row gives Flux8=2.07296±1.54933×10^-14 erg cm^-2 s^-1 in 0.2–12 keV for ObsID 0300870501. Ridder+23 Table 3 lists 1–10 keV=1.6±1.5×10^-14 and 0.1–10 keV=2.1±1.5×10^-14. Section 3.2 describes subtracting bands 1 and 2 for 1–10 keV and using the full-band error; the exact per-detection band vector and source-specific NH/model are not in the saved slim source row. Hilton+09 reports a contemporaneous <0.0160 ct/s 3-sigma pn limit under high background.
issues.why_it_matters: Comparisons across CV classes can be biased if compiled X-ray fluxes mix native observed catalog fluxes, approximate bands, and absorption-corrected fluxes.
issues.needed_action: Verify the full 4XMM-DR11 per-detection band fluxes and Ridder conversion for ObsID 0300870501, then document the source-specific NH and absorbed/unabsorbed convention. Preserve all three records until reproduced.

issues.parameter: Radio-emission mechanism and conditional kG field
issues.competing_evidence: Barrett+20 reports a VLA X-band 43±15 μJy continuum value and CP=-100±41%; its custom S/N=10.3 is not Stokes-I/error (≈2.9). Table 2’s 3210±365 G requires fundamental ECM and a radio-region interpretation; the emitting component/site is not directly localized.
issues.why_it_matters: A conditional radio-plasma field must not enter WD-surface-field comparisons or imply an established radio mechanism.
issues.needed_action: Choose whether the community-facing catalog should expose 3210±365 G in a separately typed conditional radio-region field or only preserve it in provenance notes; it must remain separate from WD fields.

issues.parameter: Stream-model M1, inclination, q, and Roche-lobe assumptions
issues.competing_evidence: Kolbin+23’s Hα stream fit uses M1=0.65 M_sun, i=55 deg, bright-segment elongation 7 deg, and a Roche-lobe-filling donor as model inputs. A separate compact-emitter eclipse scenario would require q≈0.0016, which the authors call uncharacteristic.
issues.why_it_matters: These values can be mistaken for dynamical masses, measured mass ratio, inclination, or confirmed semidetached status if copied into scalar physical-property fields.
issues.needed_action: Confirm the public-catalog convention for displaying non-measured model inputs. Current measured WD mass, measured q, and measured inclination fields are left unset; the scenarios are preserved only as labeled model rows.
